speech.heard: Fossil fuel depletion swallows 57.2% of gross national income in East Timor. It covers coal, crude oil and natural gas measured against remaining reserve lifetime. East Timor has 114 times what India has at 0.5%. Oman sits at 24%. Angola follows close behind at 22.5%. Russia has 8.6%. Nigeria is 2.7%. Brazil hits 2.3%. The median country sits near 0.04%, while nations like Mali and Uganda drop to 0%. How much of your nation's wealth vanishes into coal, oil and gas?
